$before = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'adria-before.json'
$after = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'adria-after.json'
Set-Content -Path $before -Value '{"hook_event_name":"beforeShellExecution","command":"python cursor-inbox-verify-912.py","cwd":"C:\\Users\\Faris\\Desktop\\Projects\\Adria-Hack-AI-Project"}' -Encoding ascii
Set-Content -Path $after -Value '{"hook_event_name":"afterShellExecution","command":"python cursor-inbox-verify-912.py","cwd":"C:\\Users\\Faris\\Desktop\\Projects\\Adria-Hack-AI-Project","output":"ok","duration":12}' -Encoding ascii
Write-Output '--- before ---'
curl.exe -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7777/hook/cursor -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$before"
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '--- after ---'
curl.exe -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7777/hook/cursor -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$after"

curl.exe -sS http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/groups
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '--- logs ---'
curl.exe -sS "http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/logs?q=cursor-inbox-verify-912&limit=5"
